text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mejiro Dober—

Following Mejiro Dober's gaze,
there was a claw machine filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! I was just looking.
Just thinking your chibi drawings are really good...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's really stylized well.
It captures everyone's features perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if we can catch a lot.
Just a little bit—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if we can catch a lot.
Just a little bit—"

text_block_list.name: High School Girls
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a crane game!
C'mon, someone give it a shot! It'd be so hilarious!
Haha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Never mind.
Let's go, Trainer.
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
